milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate close enough to the jungle temple and face it, confirming visual observation. Target is the temple center at (13, 4, 13) relative to spawn. max_distance=16 allows seeing the large structure from outside its walls. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the temple.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate toward the bamboo grove and face it, confirming visual observation. Target is the bamboo cluster center at (-8, 3, 2) relative to spawn. max_distance=10 ensures the player has walked toward the bamboo (it's ~8-10 blocks from spawn in the opposite direction from the temple). facing_tolerance=60 accounts for the spread of the bamboo cluster across multiple stalks.
